link.title: Solids
link.description: Solids are the fully enclosed, watertight shapes at the top of the OCCT hierarchy, and the only ones that can be reliably 3D printed or handed to a manufacturer. A solid has a defined inside and outside, which is what makes boolean operations, volume calculations and wall thickness meaningful. These pages cover the solid primitives - boxes, spheres, cylinders, cones - creating solids from closed shells, and measuring properties such as volume and centre of mass. They also cover the checks that tell you whether a shape is genuinely a valid solid before you export it.
